messages.content: The Westin confirmation has the wrong dates. It says Friday, August 21 through Thursday, August 27. We are arriving Saturday the 22nd and leaving Friday the 28th. Please correct it without changing anything else.

I can request a date-only correction on confirmation WJI-8247316. Before I submit it, I will require the hotel to retain the partial ocean-view king for Avery Thompson and Morgan Thompson, the six-night total of $2,065.68, the $344.28 deposit already charged, and the existing cancellation terms. Should I proceed only if all of those remain unchanged?
Yes. Do not accept a different room, a higher total, or a new cancellation deadline. It should still be six nights.
Understood. I am requesting Saturday, August 22 check-in and Friday, August 28 check-out as a correction to the existing six-night reservation, with no other modifications.

The hotel has corrected the reservation. Confirmation WJI-8247316 now shows check-in Saturday, August 22 and check-out Friday, August 28, for six nights. The partial ocean-view king and both guest names remain attached to the booking.
Verify the money and cancellation date too. I want the figures stated plainly.

The total remains $2,065.68. The hotel confirms that the $344.28 deposit already charged was transferred to the corrected dates and no additional charge was made. The remaining $1,721.40 is still due at the hotel. Cancellation remains free through 11:59 p.m. Jekyll Island local time on August 18; at 12:00 a.m. on August 19, the $344.28 deposit becomes nonrefundable.
And there is no separate replacement reservation sitting open for the incorrect dates?

Correct. The original reservation was amended in place under WJI-8247316. There is no second booking for August 21-27, and the corrected reservation is the only active Westin stay: partial ocean-view king, August 22-28, six nights, $2,065.68 total.
